children.description: Achrioptera manga is a species of phasmid or stick insect of the genus Achrioptera, found in Madagascar and the Comoros Archipelago.

children.description: Nesiophasma giganteum is a recently described species of stick insect, order Phasmatodea.

children.description: Phasmotaenia lanyuhensis is a species of stick insect, order Phasmatodea.

children.name: Pterinoxylus spinulosus
children.description: Pterinoxylus spinulosus is a species of stick insect found in the Neotropics.

children.name: Ramulus thaii
children.description: Ramulus thaii is a species of stick insect in the tribe Clitumnini.

children.name: Medauroidea extradentata
children.description: Medauroidea extradentata, commonly known as the Vietnamese or Annam walking stick, is a species of the family Phasmatidae.

children.name: Pharnacia sumatrana
children.description: Pharnacia sumatrana or Sumatran Stick Insect is a species of stick insect endemic to Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Java.

children.name: Phobaeticus kirbyi
children.description: Phobaeticus kirbyi is species of stick insect native to Borneo.

children.name: Phobaeticus serratipes
children.description: Phobaeticus serratipes (formerly known as Pharnacia serratipes) is a species of stick insect that at one time was the longest known insect, with one female specimen recorded as being in total length.

children.name: Phobaeticus chani
children.description: Phobaeticus chani, the Chan's megastick (also known by its synonym Sadyattes chani), is a species of stick insect in the tribe Pharnaciini, native to the southeast Asian island of Borneo.

children.name: Extatosoma popa
children.description: Extatosoma popa is a species of stick insect in the genus Extatosoma from New Guinea.

children.name: Extatosoma tiaratum
children.description: Extatosoma tiaratum, commonly known as the spiny leaf insect, the Australian giant prickly stick insect, Macleay's spectre, or the Australian walking stick, is a large species of Australian stick insect.

children.name: Vasilissa walkeri
children.description: Vasilissa is a monotypic genus of phasmids belonging to the family Phasmatidae.

children.name: Acanthoxyla inermis
children.description: Acanthoxyla inermis (the unarmed stick insect) is an insect that was described by John Salmon in 1955.

children.name: Acanthoxyla prasina
children.description: Acanthoxyla prasina, commonly known as the prickly stick insect, is a stick insect species in the order Phasmatodea and family Phasmatidae.

children.name: Clitarchus hookeri
children.description: Clitarchus hookeri, commonly known as the smooth stick insect or the common stick insect, is a stick insect of the family Phasmatidae, endemic to New Zealand.

children.name: Clitarchus rakauwhakanekeneke
children.description: Clitarchus rakauwhakanekeneke is a stick insect that belongs the common New Zealand genus Clitarchus.

children.name: Clitarchus tepaki
children.description: Clitarchus tepaki is a stick insect that belongs to the common New Zealand genus Clitarchus.

children.name: Acrophylla titan
children.description: Acrophylla titan, the titan stick insect, is the third-longest stick insect found in Australia.

children.name: Acrophylla wuelfingi
children.description: Acrophylla wuelfingi, also commonly known as the giant northern stick insect or Wülfing's stick-insect, is a species of stick insect belonging to the taxonomic tribe Phasmatini.

children.name: Acrophylla alta
children.description: Acrophylla alta is a species of stick insect in the tribe Phasmatini described in 2025.

children.name: Anchiale austrotessulata
children.description: Anchiale austrotessulata (synonyms include Ctenomorphodes tessulatus), the tessellated stick insect, tessellated phasmid or tessulata stick insect, is a medium-sized, stick insect found in the Brisbane area of Australia.

children.name: Anchiale modesta
children.description: Anchiale modesta is a medium-sized stick insect from Papua New Guinea.

children.name: Ctenomorpha gargantua
children.description: Ctenomorpha gargantua, the gargantuan stick insect, is a species of stick insect that is endemic to rainforests in northeastern Queensland, Australia.

children.name: Ctenomorpha marginipennis
children.description: Ctenomorpha marginipennis, the margin-winged stick insect, is a species of stick insect endemic to southern Australia.

children.name: Eurycnema goliath
children.description: Eurycnema goliath, commonly known as the goliath stick insect, or the regal stick insect, is a large species of stick insect in the family Phasmatidae, endemic to Australia and considered one of the largest species of stick insects in the country.

children.name: Eurycnema versirubra
children.description: Eurycnema versirubra, the red-winged green giant stick insect/Timor Giant Stick Insect, is a species of stick insect from Timor, Solor, and Wetar, The original habitat of Eurycnema versirubra might be Timor and / or closeby islands.

children.name: Onchestus rentzi
children.description: Onchestus rentzi is an Australian species of stick insect, commonly named the crowned stick insect, described in 2006.

children.name: Phasma gigas
children.description: Phasma gigas is a large-sized stick insect found in Maluku Islands, Gorong Islands and Kei Islands.

children.name: Phasma reinwardtii
children.description: Phasma reinwardtii is a large stick insect found in West Papua and Papua New Guinea.

children.name: Acanthograeffea denticulata
children.description: Acanthograeffea denticulata, also known as the Mariana walkingstick or denticulate stick insect, is the sole species of stick insect present in the Mariana Islands, where it is endemic.

children.name: Megacrania batesii
children.description: Megacrania batesii, commonly known as the peppermint stick insect, is an unusual species of stick insect found in northeastern Australia, the Bismarck Archipelago, the Solomon Islands, New Guinea, and possibly as far north as the Philippines.

children.name: Tropidoderus childrenii
children.description: Tropidoderus childrenii, the Children's stick insect, was first described in 1833 by Gray.

children.name: Didymuria violescens
children.description: Didymuria violescens, the spur legged phasmid, also known as the violet-winged stick insect, or violet-winged phasma, is a common phasmid native to Australia.

children.name: Neophryganistria tamdaoensis
children.description: Neophryganistria tamdaoensis, originally described as Phryganistria tamdaoensis, is a species of stick insect belonging to the family of giant stick insects.

children.name: Tectarchus huttoni
children.description: Tectarchus huttoni is a species of stick insect in the family Phasmatidae.

children.name: Tectarchus ovobessus
children.description: Tectarchus ovobessus, the ridgebacked stick insect, is a species of Diapheromeridae.

children.name: Micrarchus hystriculeus
children.description: Micrarchus hystriculeus is a species of flightless stick insect (order Phasmatodea) in the family Phasmatidae, and is endemic to New Zealand.
